Changelog

oopr 0.3.0 (2026-10-19)

Added

  • Public constructors can now be marked as final, to prevent being inherited by other classes.

  • Abstract virtual methods, which enforces derived classes to implement.

  • Class members now ensure incoming values from assignment match the same class type.

  • [[ & [[<- operators for ooprC objects, which do not call completion.

  • OoprBreakpoints now has an interface through the R console.

Changed

  • Classes with a private constructor can no longer be inherited at compile-time.

  • Classes with a non-public constructor can no longer be a class member at compile-time.

Fixed

  • Completion for method arguments works again, regression from 0.2.0.

  • Help completion for members no longer displays A in R < 4.3.0.

oopr 0.2.0 (2026-09-06)

Added

  • Constructor methods can now be used with any access specifier, allowing for inherit-only classes and static-only classes.

Changed

  • is.oopr and is.ooprC now also validates the structure of their objects.

  • Instancing of classes now ~20% quicker.

  • Constructor methods are now forced to be braced, preventing errors when inheriting or having class members.

  • Access specifiers are now enforced to be listed first.

  • Generated constructor usage for roxygen documentation will now separate arguments over multiple lines if too wide.

  • R 4.1.x is no longer supported.

Fixed

  • Method source reference no longer covers the access specifier, and no longer includes any comments in between.

  • Documentation now uses \command instead of \code macro for escaping roxygen markdown. Using \if inside \code macro had R CMD CHECK warning.

  • Constructors & destructors can no longer have non-access specifiers.

  • Constructors & destructors can no longer be referred to inside methods.

oopr 0.0.1 (2026-07-28)

Added

  • Documentation for RStudio help completion with class members and method arguments.

  • Lists of members in roxygen documentation include some specifiers.

  • Hyperlinks to jump to class sections and their methods.

  • .Rbuildignore can be added to @keywords tag to build ignore the Rd file.

  • Vignette for using Roxygen2 to document oopr classes.

  • Non-documented fields are now be copied from constructor @param.

  • Ability to document protected members.

Changed

  • OoprMap$keys now returns character(0L) instead of NULL if container is empty.

  • Using roxygen2 @inherits class$member can now pull documentation from within the same class.

  • When inheriting fields that are also inherited, the active binding is used instead of creating a new one. This speeds up access.

Fixed

  • OoprCovr$class identifies filename of correct class.

  • Multiple @param for methods now ordered by the methods signature.

  • Inherited @description is no longer appended in the methods list.

oopr 0.0.0.9000 (2026-06-20)

  • Initial public repo
